hook.text: Stainless steel bioreactors cost millions and take months to clean — disposable plastic bags changed the game.

buildup.text: Single-use bioreactors come pre-sterilized — no cleaning validation, no cross-contamination between batches.

discovery.text: Flexible manufacturing lets companies switch products in days — critical for personalized medicine and pandemics.

twist.text: Plastic waste is the downside — thousands of bags per year go to landfill. The industry is exploring recycling.

climax.text: Single-use systems now go up to 6,000 liters — large enough for commercial antibody production.

punchline.text: Use it once and toss it — disposable bioreactors trade waste for speed.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of single-use bioreactors over stainless steel?
options: They produce higher yields of protein per liter
They eliminate cleaning validation and allow rapid changeover between products
They are more environmentally friendly than stainless steel
